strategies.name: EMA / RSI / ATR trend follower
strategies.description: The original Pipwise rules. Signals record parameter variants as labels like v1|bull50-70|bear30-50|atr1.5|rr2.

strategies.name: Donchian channel breakout
strategies.description: BUY when the close breaks above the highest high of the previous n candles, SELL when it breaks below the lowest low.

strategies.name: RSI dip in a trend
strategies.description: In an uptrend (EMA 50 above EMA 200) BUY when RSI 14 falls below the level; in a downtrend SELL when it rises above 100 minus the level.

strategies.name: Bollinger band reversion
strategies.description: BUY when the close is below the lower band (20-candle average minus k standard deviations), SELL when above the upper band.

strategies.name: EMA 20/50 cross with trend strength
strategies.description: BUY when EMA 20 crosses above EMA 50 while ADX 14 is at least the level; SELL on the opposite cross.
